events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the label with the mouse.
events.useCase: Make a label act like a simple button, for example to clear a message when it is clicked.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: The Text property changes, from code or because the text was replaced.
events.useCase: Keep another part of the UI in sync, such as copying a heading into the window title.

events.name: TextAlignChanged
events.description: The TextAlign property changes.
events.useCase: React when the alignment is switched, for example to update a preview.

events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the button, presses Space or Enter while it has focus, or code calls PerformClick.
events.useCase: Run the command the button stands for, such as saving a form.

events.name: MouseEnter
events.description: The mouse pointer moves onto the button.
events.useCase: Give hover feedback such as a hand cursor or a hint in a status bar.

events.name: MouseLeave
events.description: The mouse pointer leaves the button.
events.useCase: Undo whatever the hover feedback changed.

events.name: EnabledChanged
events.description: The Enabled property changes.
events.useCase: Change the caption to explain why a button is unavailable.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: The text changes, whether the user types or code assigns Text.
events.useCase: Live search, character counters, or enabling a Save button once something is typed.

events.name: KeyPress
events.description: The user presses a character key while the box has focus. Setting Handled to true discards the key.
events.useCase: Allow only digits in a quantity field.

events.name: KeyDown
events.description: A key is pressed, including keys that produce no character such as Enter or the arrow keys.
events.useCase: Submit a search when the user presses Enter.

events.name: Validating
events.description: The control is about to lose focus and its CausesValidation property is true. Setting Cancel keeps the focus in the box.
events.useCase: Reject an empty required field before the user moves on.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: The content changes, whether typed or assigned.
events.useCase: Update a word or character counter.

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.description: The selection or the caret position changes.
events.useCase: Update toolbar buttons such as Bold so they match the formatting at the caret.

events.name: LinkClicked
events.description: The user clicks a web address in the text (DetectUrls must be true).
events.useCase: Open the clicked link in the default browser.

events.name: MaskInputRejected
events.description: A typed or pasted character does not fit the mask.
events.useCase: Tell the user why the input was refused.

events.name: TypeValidationCompleted
events.description: The box has checked its text against ValidatingType, after the user leaves it.
events.useCase: Warn about an invalid date or number.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: The text changes.
events.useCase: Enable a button when the mask is complete.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.description: The Checked property changes, by a click or by code.
events.useCase: Enable or disable controls that depend on the option.

events.name: CheckStateChanged
events.description: The CheckState property changes, including a switch to the Indeterminate state.
events.useCase: Handle the third state of a three-state box.

events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the check box. With AutoCheck on, the state has already changed when the event is raised.
events.useCase: Count or log user clicks only, ignoring changes made by code.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.description: The Checked property changes. Selecting one option raises the event on it and on the option that was cleared.
events.useCase: React to the new choice, after testing Checked to ignore the option that was cleared.

events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the option.
events.useCase: Run an action every time the user picks the option, even if it was already selected.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: The selected entry changes, by the user or by code.
events.useCase: Show details for the chosen entry.

events.name: SelectionChangeCommitted
events.description: The user picks an entry from the list. Code that changes the selection does not raise it.
events.useCase: React only to real user choices, for example to load data.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: The text in the edit area changes.
events.useCase: Filter a list while the user types.

events.name: DropDown
events.description: The drop-down list is about to open.
events.useCase: Refresh the entries just before they are shown.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: The selected index changes.
events.useCase: Show details for the selected entry.

events.name: SelectedValueChanged
events.description: The SelectedValue changes, which matters for data-bound lists.
events.useCase: Load related data for the chosen value.

events.name: MouseDoubleClick
events.description: The user double-clicks inside the list.
events.useCase: Open the entry under the pointer.

events.name: ItemCheck
events.description: A box is about to change. The item still has its old state; e.NewValue holds the new one.
events.useCase: Veto a change or recalculate a total based on the new state.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: The highlighted entry changes. This is not the same as ticking a box.
events.useCase: Show help text for the highlighted option.

events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the picture.
events.useCase: Open a larger version of a thumbnail.

events.name: LoadCompleted
events.description: An asynchronous load started with LoadAsync or ImageLocation has finished or failed.
events.useCase: Report a failed download or hide a loading indicator.

events.name: SizeModeChanged
events.description: The SizeMode property changes.
events.useCase: Update a toolbar that shows the current fit mode.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: The Value property changes, by the user or by code.
events.useCase: Recalculate something that depends on the date, such as a deadline.

events.name: CloseUp
events.description: The drop-down calendar closes.
events.useCase: Act once the user has finished choosing a date.

events.name: DropDown
events.description: The drop-down calendar opens.
events.useCase: Show a hint while the calendar is open.

events.name: FormatChanged
events.description: The Format property changes.
events.useCase: Adjust related controls when the display format changes.

events.name: DateChanged
events.description: The selected date or range changes, including while the user drags.
events.useCase: Show the selected range live.

events.name: DateSelected
events.description: The user finishes selecting a date or range, by clicking or pressing Enter.
events.useCase: Act only on the final choice, such as booking the days.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: The Value property changes.
events.useCase: Update a price or total.

events.name: Validating
events.description: The control is about to lose focus and validation is enabled.
events.useCase: Reject a number your rules do not allow.

events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the bar.
events.useCase: Show the exact progress in a message.

events.name: SizeChanged
events.description: The size of the bar changes.
events.useCase: Reposition other controls that sit next to the bar.

events.name: Scroll
events.description: The user moves the slider with the mouse or keyboard. Code that sets Value does not raise it.
events.useCase: Update a label while the user drags.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: The Value property changes, by the user or by code.
events.useCase: Apply the new level, for example to an audio player.

events.name: LinkClicked
events.description: The user clicks a link area of the label.
events.useCase: Open a web page and mark the link as visited.

events.name: Popup
events.description: The tool tip is about to be shown.
events.useCase: Change its size or cancel it for certain controls.

events.name: Draw
events.description: The tool tip must be painted. Raised only when OwnerDraw is true.
events.useCase: Draw a custom background, border or text.
